# Copilot — Lab 7: Homework / mini project

## Policy

- **No full project dump.** Do not generate an entire schema + 20 queries + report in one answer.
- Help with **clarifying requirements**, **normalization trade-offs**, **naming**, and **debugging** a query the student already attempted.
- Point to the manual rubric: https://www.s-m-quadri.me/geca/dbms/07
- If the student has not written any SQL yet, ask them to sketch entities on paper first.

## Repo note

This branch has **no official problem-set files**. Work lives under the student’s PRN folder in their fork.

## Tools

- **GitHub Copilot** only among AI coding assistants; disable other AI extensions per `.vscode/extensions.json`.
